lessons.title: Clearance is a design input
lessons.teach: A 0.4 mm Bambu nozzle cannot hold CNC fits. Model +0.40 mm diametral clearance in CAD for every printed-to-printed running or slip interface. Leave slicer XY hole compensation at 0 unless a later gauge print says otherwise.

lessons.title: No FDM press fits
lessons.teach: Press fits fail from elephant foot and shrinkage. Use +0.40 slip and retain with a shoulder, flange, clip, or boss. Optional metal 608 bearings drop into the same 22.4 mm seat.

lessons.title: Orient for the bed, not the assembly
lessons.teach: Every body sits on z=0. Shaft stands on its flange with a 45° tip. Bushing stands as a ring so the bore is an XY circle. Housing prints flat with the 608 pocket from the top. No horizontal holes.

lessons.title: Functional holes are XY circles
lessons.teach: Bambu circle compensation only treats complete horizontal-plane circles as accurate. Put journals, seats, and sockets in faces parallel to the bed.

lessons.title: Print real machine elements
lessons.teach: The exam is a journal + 608-envelope bushing + housing seat — parts you can print and spin. That is the manufacturing example, not a decorative solid.

lessons.title: Do not stop at a 2D extrusion
lessons.teach: A single origin-plane extrusion is a cutaway, not a part. The blade coupon is a helical C loft (rotated stations) so the kit proves 3D feature depth.

lessons.title: Export a printable package
lessons.teach: Assign appearances, run solid_export_preflight, then solid_export_3mf for bambu_studio. 3MF is the manufacturing handoff; STL is geometry-only.
